prompt: C#: safely wrap an index; return zero when count is not positive.
target: static int SafeWrapIndex(int index, int count) => count <= 0 ? 0 : ((index % count) + count) % count;
acceptance: Returns zero when count is zero or negative.
For positive count, result is always in [0, count).

prompt: C#: subtract cost only when cost is nonnegative and affordable.
target: static bool TrySpend(int balance, int cost, out int remaining) { remaining = balance; if (cost < 0 || balance < cost) return false; remaining = balance - cost; return true; }
acceptance: Rejects negative costs and costs above balance.
On rejection, leaves remaining equal to balance.
On success, subtracts cost exactly once.

prompt: Godot C#: normalize Vector2 input only when its length exceeds one.
target: static Vector2 SafeMoveInput(Vector2 input) => input.LengthSquared() > 1f ? input.Normalized() : input;
acceptance: Inputs of length at most one are unchanged.
Longer inputs return a unit direction.

prompt: C#: apply flat armor, never heal, and floor health at zero.
target: static int DamageAfterArmor(int health, int damage, int armor) => Math.Max(0, health - Math.Max(0, damage - Math.Max(0, armor)));
acceptance: Negative damage and armor do not increase health.
Armor reduces damage but cannot make damage negative.

prompt: C#: decrement timer only by nonnegative delta and floor at zero.
target: static float TickTimer(float timer, float delta) => Math.Max(0f, timer - Math.Max(0f, delta));
acceptance: Negative delta does not increase timer.

prompt: C#: multiply nonnegative score by a nonnegative multiplier.
target: static int MultiplyScore(int score, int multiplier) => Math.Max(0, score) * Math.Max(0, multiplier);
acceptance: Negative score and multiplier are treated as zero.
